parsed_json.up: Select JAK2-targeted IC50 activity rows with provenance and structures. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, compound_records, and compound_structures. Filter target_dictionary.pref_name for JAK2 and activities.standard_type for IC50. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
